title: Show each department's high earners
prompt: Return department (the department's name) and first_name for the employees who earn more than 150000. Every department must appear at least once. A department with no such employee appears as one row with NULL for first_name. Sort by department, then first_name.
hints: Which table has to keep all its rows?
A test on the employee in WHERE would remove the departments that have no match.
FROM departments AS d LEFT JOIN employees AS e ON e.department_id = d.id AND e.salary > 150000

wrongAnswers.misconception: Puts the salary test in WHERE, which removes the departments with no match.
Leaves out the salary test and lists every employee.

feedback: Count the departments in your result. All six must be there, including the ones with nobody above 150000.
